Calculate MEQ values

Source: R/calculations.R
meq.Rd

Calculates MEQ values for 'long' data in mg/L. Expects output of either fetch_renmods() or fmt_minimal().

Usage

meq(samples)

Arguments

samples

Data frame. Output from fmt_minimal() or fetch_renmods(). If fetch_renmods() samples will be first formatted with fmt_minimal().

Details

For conversion details and a description of the data see meq_conversion().

MEQs are calculated by dividing the parameter concentration in mg/L by the conversion factor. "result_unit" is required to ensure the units are in mg/L before calculating MEQs

Note: This is an internal function, exported for clarity in calculations

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
s <- data.frame(observed_property_id = "", result_value = "", result_unit = "")
meq(s)

s <- fetch_renmods(
  ems_ids = c("1401030", "1401377"),
  date_range = c("2020-01-01", "2022-02-01")
)

meq(s)

fmt_minimal(s)
fmt_wide(s)
}
